rules.rule: PR261 and PR274 evidence may be preserved because both were merged and referenced files are present on the current canonical branch
the three EA numeric rows are preserved historical official measurements, not newly produced in Increment165
status_latest remains 340/381 and 78 percent until existing F-host receipts and acceptance outputs are verified
EA numeric acceptance requires recorded WCS coverage identity, image/tiff response, byte count, SHA256, EPSG27700 transform and valid pixel counts
exact HMLR acceptance requires exact INSPIRE ID, native EPSG27700 polygon, point-inside, ZIP/GML/feature hash chain
P_12151 and P_10768 both intersect the Composite catalogue; no single current survey is inferred
P_10782 and P_10767 are the single returned Composite candidates for rows 46142 and 61522 respectively
P_7338, P_4927 and P_4953 are historical Time Stamped lineage support and are not substituted for current Composite pixels
historical OSTN02/OSGM02 lineage is retained as historical provenance; it does not rewrite the EPSG27700 Composite measurement
no Terrain50 numeric crosscheck until actual current archive/ASCII bytes are obtained and validated
National LIDAR Programme exact target intersection remains an independent QA check and is not inferred from Composite coverage
tool or DNS failures are transport failures, not NO_DATA
preserved official measurements are support evidence and do not create production business rows
